items.title: Apollo 11: Catching Some Sun
items.summary: Bright sunlight glints as long dark shadows mark this image of the surface of the Moon. It was taken on July 20, 1969, by Apollo 11 astronaut Neil Armstrong, the first to walk on the lunar surface. Pictured is the mission's lunar module, the Eagle, and spacesuited lunar module pilot Buzz Aldrin. Aldrin is unfurling a long sheet of foil also known as the Solar Wind Composition Experiment. items.label: Poem
items.title: יהודה הלוי — שער שיבה בהראות יחידי
items.summary:
שְׂעַר שֵׂיבָה בְּהֵרָאוֹת יְחִידִי
עֲלֵי רֹאשִי קְטַפְטִיהוּ בְיָדִי
הֳשִׁיבַנִי יְכָלְתּנִי לְבַדִּי
וּמַה תַּעְשֶׂה בְּבֹא אַחֲרַי גְּדוּדִי.

items.title: Archaeologists Discover the World's Oldest Evidence of Habitual Drug Use in the Teeth of a Hunter-Gatherer Who Lived Up to 25,000 Years Ago
